note: What comes back from a model, and what becomes of it. Separate from the prompts on purpose: one says what we ask, this says what we do with what arrives, and they change for different reasons. Two things decide the outcome and only one of them is the answer — WHERE the line came from outranks what happened to it, which is the half that has been wrong twice. A game shows what comes back verbatim, so everything a model wraps around its translation reaches a player's screen unless it is taken off here. The refusal marker is AxNoTranslateXa and it means a refusal only when it is the WHOLE answer.
